title: Billing and Coding: Bladder/Urothelial Tumor Markers

covered.1: R31.21 or R31.29 are to be used only when repeat testing is believed to be medically reasonable and necessary, and must be listed as secondary with the primary neoplastic diagnosis. Z78.9 To be used only when repeat testing is believed to be medically reasonable and necessary, and must be listed as secondary with the primary neoplastic diagnosis.
